name: Brother DCP-L2620DW
type: Mono laser all-in-one (print, copy, flatbed scan)
variants: Same machine in every region; EU code DCPL2620DWRE1, UK DCPL2620DWZU1. Siblings that look alike but are different: DCP-L2640DN/L2660DW (document feeder on top, 31.9 cm tall, Ethernet), DCP-L2627DW/L2622DW (regional twins).

closed.includes: Brother's 'typical outline view': width is the scanner/lid (the lower body is narrower, about 38.8 cm at the top tapering to 36 cm at the feet); depth runs from the paper-tray/front-cover face to the rear of the scanner unit and lid hinges (the upper rear overhang). The lower back with the plugs sits about 4.5 cm in front of that rear line. Output support flap folded.

max.what: from the 3D model, not published by Brother: depth with the output support flap flipped out 42.4 cm; height with the scanner lid raised (about 80 deg, as in the lid-open photo) 58.7 cm; with the paper tray pulled out to load paper the depth is 69.9 cm

weight_kg.what: with drum and inbox toner installed

connectivity.note: No Ethernet: Brother's own spec page lists Wired LAN only for the DCP-L2640DN/L2660DW and MFC models, and the back photo shows a blank plate where the LAN socket sits on network models. The brother.co.uk product page (and bug.co.il, which copies it) has a stray 'Wired Interface: Fast Ethernet' row, but its own 'Connectivity' row says 'USB, Wireless'.

paper.input_type: front cassette (pull it fully out to load)
paper.output_type: face-down tray under the scanner, with a flip-out support flap
paper.manual_feed: single-sheet slot in the front cover
paper.rear_output: back cover opens as a 1-sheet face-up exit for thick paper

in_the_box.items: Printer with drum unit and starter (inbox) toner already installed (about 700 pages), power cord, quick setup guide, warranty card. No USB cable, no software disc (drivers are downloaded).
in_the_box.region: Israel (bug.co.il listing); Brother UK lists the same: power supply cord, quick setup guide, warranty, device, supplies, drum
in_the_box.notes: bug.co.il: 'מדפסת | טונר | מחסנית | כבל חשמל | מדריך הפעלה מהירה | גלויית אחריות', and 'כבל USB: לא כלול'.

ils.where: zap.co.il, lowest of 17 shops (א.ר לייזר ליין, טונר פלוס, פרי דיו)

usd.note: not sold in the US; converted from £165.90 at 1.3195 $/£ (x-rates, 17 Nov 2026)

power.type: C13 (IEC kettle plug; C14 inlet mounted turned 90°, long side vertical)
power.position: 4.0 cm from the left edge seen from behind (the printer's right side), 11.3 cm up
power.plug_inside_outline: mostly: the inlet is on the lower back, which sits 4.5 cm in front of the rear line set by the scanner overhang above it; the plug and strain relief (about 5.8 cm) end only a few mm past that line before the cord bends down

data.position: 37.0 cm from the left edge seen from behind (the printer's left side), 7.1 cm up, in a vertical channel with a light-grey blanking plate above it

cable_space.why: Both sockets are on the lower back, 4.5 cm in front of the rear line of the scanner overhang, so the plugs sit inside the printer's outline and only the bent cord needs room: the user's 'concave' case, about 1-2 cm from the wall.
cable_space.source: back photo https://bie-p-001-delivery.sitecorecontenthub.cloud/api/public/content/ce364d0225274a9ab569c7e8e1edbcc2?v=0d986036 ; side outline https://support.brother.com/g/s/id/htmldoc/mfc/cv_dcpl2508dw/uke/img/GUID-7FDA5A65-C6AA-4A3C-9ECC-A84FFA48C244-low.gif ; QSG power-cord drawing https://download.brother.com/welcome/doc101432/cv_dcpl2508dw_chne_qsg.pdf

notes: The official 39.9 cm depth already includes the rear overhang, and the plugs hide under it. The control panel juts out over the paper exit but stays about 1 cm behind the front face. To load paper the whole cassette slides out of the front (about 30 cm). The scanner lid opens upward from hinges at the back; raised (about 80 deg) its top edge is 58.7 cm above the shelf, so it needs about 32 cm of free height above the printer.
